class.name: com.simplysoftware.OPCUAClient.OPCUAClient
class.comment: OPC UA Client library. This class provides a bridge to OPC UA services including endpoint discovery, session management, subscription monitoring, and data communication.
class.event: ReadResult (NodeId As String, Value As Object, Status As String)
WriteResult (NodeId As String, Success As Boolean)
SubscriptionValueChanged (NodeId As String, Value As Object, Timestamp As Long)

method.name: Write
method.comment: Writes a value to an node. NodeIdString is the OPC UA node identifier such as ns=2;s=MyNode. Value is the new value to write. Raises WriteResult or ConnectionError.

method.name: ConnectWithCertificate
method.comment: Connect using a client certificate (PKCS#12) and anonymous user identity. EndpointUrl: opc.tcp://host:port/... p12Path: full path to the .p12/.pfx file p12Password: password for the keystore Raises Connected or ConnectionError.

method.name: ConnectAutoSecure
method.comment: Connects using the strongest secure endpoint available. Automatically selects the best SecurityPolicy and MessageSecurityMode. Uses anonymous authentication. Raises Connected or ConnectionError.

method.name: UnsubscribeAll
method.comment: Unsubscribe all monitored subscriptions.

method.name: Subscribe
method.comment: Subscribes to value changes on an node. NodeIdString is the OPC UA node identifier such as ns=2;s=MyNode. SamplingIntervalMs specifies the sampling interval in milliseconds. Raises SubscriptionValueChanged or ConnectionError.

method.name: HasSubscription
method.comment: Returns True if any active subscription contains the specified node, otherwise False. NodeIdString is the OPC UA node identifier.

method.name: Initialize
method.comment: Initialises the OPC UA client. EventName is the prefix used for all raised events.

method.name: UnSubscribe
method.comment: Unsubscribes from a specific node. Deletes the entire subscription containing that node.

method.name: Read
method.comment: Reads a single node. NodeIdString is the OPC UA node identifier such as ns=2;s=MyNode. Returns Value and Status in the ReadResult event. Raises ReadResult or ConnectionError.

method.name: Disconnect
method.comment: Disconnects from the OPC UA server. Closes the client session and releases resources. Raises Disconnected or ConnectionError.

method.name: HasMonitoredItem
method.comment: Checks if a specific NodeId is currently being monitored in any subscription.

method.name: SubscribeOnce
method.comment: Subscribes to a node only if it is not already monitored. NodeIdString is the OPC UA node identifier such as ns=2;s=MyNode. SamplingIntervalMs is the sampling interval in milliseconds.

method.name: DebugDump
method.comment: Returns a basic Map summarizing active subscriptions and items.

method.name: DebugDumpDetailed
method.comment: Returns a detailed Map containing every subscription and its monitored items currently active in the client.

method.name: ListMonitoredItems
method.comment: Returns a List of NodeIds being monitored in the given subscription.

method.name: ReadMultiple
method.comment: Reads multiple nodes. NodeIds is a List of node id strings. Raises ReadResult for each node.

method.name: WriteMultiple
method.comment: Writes multiple nodes. NodeIds is a B4X List of node id strings. Values is a B4X List of values matching the node ids. Raises WriteResult for each node.

method.name: Connect
method.comment: Connects to an OPC UA server using anonymous authentication. EndpointUrl is the OPC UA endpoint such as opc.tcp://host:4840. Selects the server's None/None endpoint. Raises Connected or ConnectionError.

method.name: BrowseFull
method.comment: Browses a node and returns full details. NodeIdString is the OPC UA node identifier such as ns=2;s=MyNode. Returns a List of Maps with NodeId, DisplayName and NodeClass. Raises BrowseResult.

method.name: ReadWrite
method.comment: Reads a value from a node, writes a new value, then reads again to verify. NodeIdString is the OPC UA node identifier. NewValue is the value to write. Raises ReadWriteResult.

method.name: ConnectAuthWithCertificate
method.comment: Connect using a client certificate (PKCS#12) for TLS and username/password for user identity. SecurityPolicyName: e.g. "Basic256Sha256" or full URI MessageSecurityModeName: e.g. "SignAndEncrypt" or "Sign" Raises Connected or ConnectionError.

method.name: ConnectAuth
method.comment: Connects to a secure OPC UA server using username and password. EndpointUrl is the OPC UA endpoint such as opc.tcp://host:4840. Username is the OPC UA user name. Password is the OPC UA password. SecurityPolicyName specifies the required security policy such as Basic256Sha256. MessageSecurityModeName specifies the required security mode such as Sign or SignAndEncrypt. Raises Connected or ConnectionError.

method.name: Browse
method.comment: Browses the specified node. NodeIdString is the OPC UA node identifier such as ns=2;s=MyNode. Returns a List of browse names. Raises BrowseResult or ConnectionError.

method.name: WriteAndVerify
method.comment: Writes a value to a node and then reads it back to verify success. NodeIdString is the node identifier. Value is the value to write. Raises WriteVerified.

method.name: SubscribeMultiple
method.comment: Subscribes to multiple nodes at once. NodeIds is a B4X List of node id strings. SamplingIntervalMs specifies the sampling interval. Raises SubscriptionValueChanged for each node.

method.name: ListSubscriptions
method.comment: Returns a List of active subscription IDs.

method.name: ConnectAutoSecureWithCertificate
method.comment: Auto secure connect: choose the strongest endpoint available, use client certificate for TLS. Anonymous user identity. Raises Connected or ConnectionError.

method.name: IsConnected
method.comment: Returns whether the client is currently connected. Returns true when the OPC UA session is active. Returns false when not connected or after a disconnect.

field.name: FireOnlyOnChange
field.comment: When set to True, subscription events are only raised when the value changes. Duplicate values are ignored even if they arrive seconds apart.

field.name: SuppressDuplicateValues
field.comment: When set to True, duplicate values arriving too quickly are suppressed. This prevents rapid duplicate events caused by server timestamp behaviour.
